subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Enemy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Enemy"** means a person who is actively opposed or hostile to someone or something. (दुश्मन)

 
 
• **Example: **In the story, the hero had to face his greatest enemy in the final battle.
 
 
 
• **"Friend" **refers to a person with whom one has a bond of mutual affection, typically one exclusive of sexual or family relations. (मित्र)
 
 
• **Example: **She has been my best friend since we were children.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Enemy' **is **'Friend'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Attacker **(आक्रमणकारी): A person who attacks someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** The attacker was quickly apprehended by the police.
 
 
 
• **Combatant **(योद्धा): A person or nation engaged in fighting during a war.
 
 
• **Example: **The combatants fought bravely on the battlefield.
 
 
 
• **Colleague** (सहकर्मी): A person with whom one works, especially in a profession or business.
 
 
• **Example:** She always collaborates well with her colleagues.

The correct answer is: Option 2</b&g
